name: next-compass
description: Four predicted next instructions in four directions above the prompt, and a meaning map to send the in-between. English and Japanese.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language. auto follows Claude Code's own language setting.

choiceLanguage.title: Language of the predictions
choiceLanguage.description: The language the four and the blended instruction are written in. auto follows the UI language, so the choices never mix languages.

keyMode.title: Key mode
keyMode.description: number: press 1-4 in the empty prompt box. arrow: lay the four out as a cross and pick with the arrow keys after focusing the band (ctrl+x tab or a click).

generator.title: Generator
generator.description: Model that writes the four and the blended instruction. haiku is cheap and reads a cached summary of the recent messages; fork asks the session's own model over the whole conversation (slower, uses the session's prompt cache). Candidates prepared while Claude works and the final pick always use haiku.

showMap.title: Show the meaning map
showMap.description: Open the meaning map pane at session start (it docks beside the transcript in a wide fullscreen terminal).

extraCount.title: Extra candidates on the map
extraCount.description: How many candidates besides the four to place on the map (0-16).
